program.name: Bell & Flow 35
program.subject: Strength & stretch
program.blurb: One kettlebell in supersets, then a yoga flow, in about thirty-five minutes.
program.about: Kettlebell strength and yoga in one short session. The bell works in supersets, presses with rows one day and squats with swings and deadlifts the next, and a yoga flow follows each. One bell and a mat cover all of it. Level II adds reps and Level III asks for a heavier bell.
program.split: Bell supersets & yoga flow A / B, 35 minutes
